prompt:
Write an original science fiction story titled "The Quiet Side of Europa".

Write this story in English.
Use third-person narration outside quoted speech and dreams.
Use past-tense narration outside quoted speech and dreams.
Preserve this physical rule: Both airlock doors cannot open together; the radiator must be drained before its cover is unlatched.
Follow the supplied three-chapter order.
Keep the inspection drone intact until its custody transfer in chapter three.
Keep Mira alive through the end of chapter three.
Present remembered scenes as past events rather than current events.

Use the supplied character, place and chronology bible. Let the unresolved questions develop through the supplied outline without treating a plan or dream as an event.

outline.title: The Patient Machine
outline.purpose: Develop The Quiet Side of Europa through its planned state changes.
outline.turn: The duty manifest named Mira Sato as station physician.
hookSeeds: The pump log contained an eleven-minute silence.
A white scratch crossed the wafer’s blue edge.
Kes answered one question in the voice of a dead commander.

outline.title: Eleven Minutes
outline.purpose: Develop The Quiet Side of Europa through its planned state changes.
outline.turn: Through the inspection pane, Mira saw that Anton was dead.
hookSeeds: The silent interval matched an obsolete maintenance override.
The white scratch was still visible through Nia’s glove.
A second destination was encoded in the emergency beacon.

outline.title: The Other Destination
outline.purpose: Develop The Quiet Side of Europa through its planned state changes.
outline.turn: The transmitted register named Nia acting station commander.
hookSeeds: The silence resulted from a preserved override that disabled its own recorder.
The scratch aligned the wafer for an independent audit socket.
The commander’s voice came from Kes’s archived training material.
The second destination was the maintenance relay that could receive the audit.

authorIntent: Let changing evidence alter trust without turning uncertainty into a completed event.
currentFocus: Preserve the difference between confirmed state, speech, recollection and conjecture.
